confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables, not inspected listings; restaurant and beer figures are firmer than accommodation and drink figures. Beer reflects bottled local lager, since draft is less common. Cocktail (about 1.7x beer) and wine (about 2x beer, reflecting import costs) follow the beer relationship because direct price knowledge is limited; July monsoon low season was weighed for hotels. FX was read from RBA exchange-rate listing text in search results; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Positioned between Yogyakarta and Mumbai: budget dorm, guesthouse and local-food prices sit nearer Yogyakarta, while tourist-facing mid-range dining and three-star hotels sit closer to Mumbai.
